records.title: 10-K
records.text: For the year ended September 27, 2025, 36% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The twelve-month backlog at September 27, 2025 increased as compared with the twelve-month backlog at September 28, 2024.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The twelve-month backlog in Military Aircraft increased due to the timing of orders for the F-35 program and new production programs.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As we record provisions within cost of sales to increase inventory valuation reserves, we establish a new, lower cost basis for the inventory.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities increased in 2025 compared to 2024.
